# `curdate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
curdate()
```

Returns the current date at the start of query evaluation. All calls of curdate within the same query return the same value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT curdate();
```

Result:

```text
2022-09-06
```
